duplicate_information_policy: Repeat source information only when it serves a different learner decision.
source_truth_policy: Source material is evidence and must not be treated as automatically correct.
automation_policy: Source files are processed outside the learner runtime. The source-to-content workflow generates a connected five-component package, independently audits Micro-topic, Deep Dive, Active Recall, Revision and Practice, publishes passing components to static pools, and places final failures in the owner approval queue. Learner pages never run generation or audit logic.
mapping_policy: Quick Learn cards and questions may be remapped automatically only when confidence is high against the canonical syllabus. Ambiguous records remain unresolved for human review.
copyright_policy: Generated learner content must summarize and transform source material; do not copy long passages from copyrighted books into the repository.
feedback_policy: Learner feedback is collected separately from learner content and may be aggregated for future AI-assisted creation or rewriting of static source-grounded content. Feedback must not alter learner content at runtime.
verification_policy: Learners may see only EXPERT VERIFIED, VERIFIED, or no verification tag. Verification status is static content metadata; internal audit state is never loaded by learner pages.
